contexts.text: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and built Nineveh... ()... Nineveh = falsities of doctrinal things... Nineveh = falsity from reasonings. AC 1187.

That by Nineveh are signified falsities of doctrinal things... is evident from the signification of Nineveh in the Word... There are falsities of this kind from three origins. The first is from the fallacies of the senses, in the obscurity of an understanding which is not illustrated, and from ignorance: hence is the falsity which is Nineveh.

That Nineveh = falsities from the fallacies of the senses, in the obscurity of an understanding which is not illustrated, and from ignorance, is evident in Jonah, who was sent to Nineveh, which city was pardoned because they were such...

In like manner in Isaiah, where it is said of the king of Asshur that he remained in Nineveh, and that when he bowed himself in the house of Nisroch his god, his sons slew him with the sword ()... Here, by Nineveh, is signified external worship in which there are falsities; and because this was idolatrous he was slain... Further illustrated.
(How it was that the science of correspondences came to be cultivated at Nineveh, etc.) DSS 102.
The Ancient Word was at Nineveh, etc.
The gentiles are signified by Nineveh (). PP 211. (.)
By Nineveh which He will place in wasteness, a dry place as the wilderness () are signified falsities of doctrine.
